title: Preservation of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Forts & Maratha Military Landscapes
prelims_pointers: Maratha Military Landscapes of India were nominated for UNESCO World Heritage recognition.
Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) under the Ministry of Culture oversees central heritage site restoration.

mains_perspective.context: Strategic efforts to preserve 17th-century coastal and hill fortresses across Maharashtra and Southern India.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Balancing heritage tourism with environmental preservation while building local eco-tourism livelihoods.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Incorporate community-led conservation frameworks and modern architectural stabilization techniques.

title: Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture & Agriculture Governance Directions
prelims_pointers: Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture is organized annually by Prasar Bharati (All India Radio).
Focuses on policy frameworks for sustainable agricultural growth, cooperative federalism, and farmer welfare.

mains_perspective.context: Evaluating structural reforms required in agricultural supply chains and institutional price stabilization.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Necessity to shift towards high-value agriculture, micro-irrigation, and decentralized cold-storage infrastructure.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Strengthen Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) and streamline digital agricultural market access.

title: Digital Public Infrastructure and Sovereign AI Stack Integration
topic: Digital Infrastructure, AI Stack & Tech Governance
prelims_pointers: India Stack includes Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker as open-standard API infrastructure layers.
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) acts as the nodal agency for the IndiaAI Mission.

mains_perspective.context: Expanding DPI architecture beyond fintech into digital agriculture, healthcare diagnostics, and sovereign AI compute.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Democratizes access to public services while incentivizing domestic technology manufacturing and data sovereignty.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Enforce strict data governance, secure cybersecurity protocols, and roll out high-speed rural digital connectivity.

title: Ethical Frameworks in Public Administration and Probity in Governance
topic: Public Service Values, Ethics & Probity in Governance
prelims_pointers: Civil Services Code of Conduct guidelines emphasize neutrality, integrity, and non-partisanship.
2nd Administrative Reforms Commission (ARC) Report 4 deals specifically with Ethics in Governance.

mains_perspective.context: Establishing transparent decision-making systems and institutional safeguards against administrative corruption.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Proactive disclosure under RTI and citizen charters reinforce public trust in executive administration.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Implement mandatory e-governance audits, whistleblower protections, and value-based training modules for civil servants.
